work_item: B05 caller-supplied explicit evidence ledger classification and declared inference links through Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: This continuation did not request test or runtime-route verification; formatting, compilation, lint and build checks only were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::EvidenceSynthesize -> ports::synthesize_explicit_evidence -> ExplicitEvidenceSynthesisReport artifact
ledger_schema: Exactly {"sources":[{"source_id":string,"independence_group":string,"claims":[{"id":string,"text":string,"stance":"SUPPORTS"|"REFUTES"}]}...],"inferences":[{"id":string,"text":string,"premises":[id,...]}...]}; all object fields are strict.
supported_behavior: Unique source IDs and per-source claim IDs, exact claim text consistency across shared claim IDs, and explicit SUPPORTS/REFUTES stances are validated.

Claims are classified as AGREEMENT across two or more distinct supplied independence_group labels, CONTRADICTION when both stances are present, SAME_GROUP_REPETITION for repeated one-stance entries inside one group, or SINGLE_SOURCE.
Source indexes, independence-group labels and claim/stance JSON byte spans are retained. Independence-group membership remains caller-supplied and unverified.
Declared inference premises must reference claim IDs or earlier inference IDs; cycles/forward references are rejected by order, but entailment and inference validity are not checked.
Input/source/claim/inference/output limits apply; duplicate JSON keys, unknown fields, malformed shapes and invalid links return typed failures.

acceptance.B05: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
